metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Sciatica Pain in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy and safe exercises that can instantly relieve sciatica pain—sometimes in as little as 30 seconds.

These exercises help reduce pressure on bulging and herniated discs, the leading cause of pinched nerves and sciatica. They also focus on fixing weakness and tightness in key muscles that can compress the sciatic nerve, including the glutes and piriformis.

To make it more helpful, the exercises are shown in different positions so you can get relief anytime and anywhere.

For the best results, go through all the exercises and use the ones that feel comfortable and give you pain relief.

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:35 Bed/Floor Exercise
3:27 Seated Exercise 1
5:39 Seated Exercise 2
7:52 Standing Exercise
10:52 Strengthening Exercise (Don't Skip!)
